rows.en: (Phew~ The test is finally over!)

You look relieved,
but how'd the test go,
\p?

I think it went fine...
And you, Michel-sensei, number one in our year?
Was it a breeze for you?
rows.notes: The player teasingly calls Michel 'Michel sensei'; kept as the honorific per the brief.

rows.en: Well, something like that's nothing.
(As expected, he's sure confident.)

Well, now that the test's over,
wanna go have some fun somewhere?
Might as well invite Alto and the others too.

(The test's finally over, so today of all days
I've gotta go all out and have some fun!)
(As expected, he's sure confident.)

(The test's finally over, so today of all days
I've gotta go all out and have some fun!)

(I wonder why Hilda-sensei called for me?
Anyway, I'd better hurry!)

Owowow...
Sorry, Michel, you okay?

Throwing yourself into my arms in broad
daylight? Were you that eager to see me?
rows.notes: Shared by the male and female scenes: Michel's tease works for both.

rows.en:
Wha-!
No, I just bumped into you, that's all...
It's not like I did it on purpose......

Haha, I'm kidding.
You're in a hurry, right? Better get going.

(Geez, that Michel...
Always saying stuff that throws me off...)

(I wonder why Hilda-sensei called for me?
Anyway, I'd better hurry!)

Owww...
Sorry, Michel-kun, are you okay?

(Geez, Michel-kun...
Always saying stuff that throws me off...)
(Phew~ Today's EX-Gear training wore me out too...)
\p, got a minute?
rows.notes: x4: Michel here; Yamashiro in scd_tri_608 (plate '??? (man)').

rows.en: Hm? You need something, Michel?

I noticed while watching today's training.
When you pull a sharp turn,
you sometimes drift to the left.

I thought I was doing it right,
but I've got a habit like that...

Also, relax a little more and try
to watch how the whole team moves.
Do that and you'll fly a lot cleaner, I bet.

I see. Thanks for the advice,
Michel.

No need to thank me.
Come on, let's hurry, change,
and get back to class.

(Michel's advice is always spot-on,
so I'd better practice until I get it right.)
(Phew~ Today's EX-Gear training wore me out too...)
Hm? You need something, Michel-kun?

I see. Thanks for the advice,
Michel-kun.

(Michel-kun's advice is always spot-on,
so I'd better practice until I get it right.)

(Now then, how should I spend
my day off tomorrow...)

Yo, \p.
Got any plans for your day off tomorrow?

Nah, nothing in particular.
That's why I was just thinking about what to do.

Geez, you're a lonely one.
You oughta be able to tell me you've
got a date lined up.

Hmph, so what if I don't?
What about you, Michel?
What are you planning to do?
Me, I've got my part-time job tomorrow.

Huh~ I see.
Come to think of it, I've never heard where
you work part-time, Michel. Where is it?
Oh, where I work is, uh...

Well, we'll talk about that properly some other time.
I just remembered something I gotta do,
so I'm heading home.
Huh? Oh, see ya...

(Michel took off like he was running away...
Is his part-time job something he can't
tell people about?)

No, nothing in particular.
That's why I was just thinking about what to do.

Hmph, so what if I don't?
What about you, Michel-kun?
What are you planning to do?

Huh~ I see.
Come to think of it, I've never heard where
you work part-time, Michel-kun. Where is it?
Huh? Oh, okay, see you...

(Michel-kun took off like he was running away...
Is his part-time job something he can't
tell people about, I wonder?)

(Next class is P.E., huh...
Hope it's nothing too tough...)
Wait, where are you going, Michel?

Hm?
Ah, I'm not feeling it today, so I'll pass.

You're skipping?
If Hilda-sensei finds out......
Is something the matter with my class, Michel?

...Why, Hilda-sensei.
Not at all, we were just saying how much
we were looking forward to seeing you.
Right, \p?

I see...
After all, skipping my class would be
unthinkable, wouldn't it?
But of course.
Come on, let's hurry up and change, \p.
(Geez, that Michel... He's such a smooth talker...)

(Next class is P.E....
Hope it's nothing too tough...)
Wait, where are you going, Michel-kun?

You're skipping?
If Hilda-sensei finds out......
(Geez, Michel-kun... He's such a smooth talker...)
